name: H04_corsair_captain_enters_with_one_treasure_that_pays_one_mana
note: Corsair Captain: 'When this creature enters, create a Treasure token.' Cast with exactly its cost ({2}{U}): exactly one Treasure token appears (not none, not two). The Treasure then pays the {U} of Aegis Turtle by tapping (the automatic payer): it is sacrificed for it, one mana and no more, and the Turtle resolves.
